scopeJustifications.collections:read:private: Lets a signed-in viewer browse and play their own private collections (behind an explicit in-app consent prompt), in addition to public ones.
scopeJustifications.social:tip:self: Sends the viewer's Buzz tip to a collection's creator or curator, within the per-tip and daily caps.
scopeJustifications.buzz:read:self: Reads the viewer's Buzz balance so a tip amount can be validated before it is sent.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:write: Records the shared popular-collections rail entries (collection references and tallies) that are visible to all viewers.
